name: Kunlun Tech Co., Ltd.
blurb: Kunlun Tech Co., Ltd. provides internet value-added services in China and internationally, including short drama and AI short drama platforms, AI music, AI games, AI social networking products, and browser advertising. The company also engages in artificial intelligence technology development, music social platforms, online game operation, and investment management. Formerly known as Beijing Kunlun Tech Co., Ltd., it changed its name in June 2021 and is headquartered in Beijing.
